title: Tyler Durden Style Sprite Flash ( VX Ace )

posts.author: Flyp1993
posts.body:
Hey all;
Not sure if this is in the right spot, it's been a long time since I've used a forum, lol.
So, if anyone is familiar with the movie Fight Club there's a few times in that movie where one of the characters flashes on screen for like, a frame, half a frame, whatever, and I'm trying to do something similar to that. I'm quite new to RPG Maker and I'm just not quite sure how to go about doing something like that.
So basically what I would like to happen is just randomly when the player walks across a tile, the screen will flash, the sprite will pop up for a moment, a dialogue box will pop up with just a "
". I'd like the sprite to be on screen for as little as possible, like you could miss it while the screen flashes if you're not paying attention.
No idea if this is something VX Ace can do or not, like I said I'm fairly new to the program, so if it's not possible is there anything close to what I'm going for that I could do?
Appreciate any insight y'all would be able to give, thanks

posts.author: heyguy
posts.body:
Definitely possible. Here's a very simple version on how to do it. In plain English, in your tile event -
Set the event to player touch
in the contents:
create a variable named random variable and set the operand to random 0-1
conditional branch if random variable = 0
flash screen
Show picture
wait 1 frame
erase picture
show text
self switch A
else
do nothing
self switch A
in self switch A page 2
set the trigger to action and have the commands empty
I haven't tried it but that should work.
